supersedes_execution_detail: EXECUTION_ADDENDUM_v3.json single-source scope and lexicographic source allocation; historical v2 source/CPU evidence remains unchanged
primary_question: Can ordinary inter-session concurrency on the same two GPUs explain the single-chain retention benefit, and what remains when canonical demand fills both workers?

runtime_change.common_policy: canonical-first round-robin source dispatch, identical across every arm
runtime_change.priority: any admissible actual-canonical-start proposal across sessions before conditional-tail proposals
runtime_change.round_robin: among eligible sources in the chosen layer; advance cursor only after actual successful dispatch
runtime_change.two_slots: select/register/send first slot, then recompute the second, never reuse stale candidate snapshots
runtime_change.constraints: same 8000-sample full step, actual accepted input, max-ahead, no duplicate work, original input/AU/SUP/durable and physical lease guards
runtime_change.claim: common resource-control policy, not a claimed algorithmic contribution
runtime_change.launch_condition: new full actual execution commit/manifest and full CPU controls; v2 CPU gate cannot certify changed v3 source; all new references generated under v3

multi_session_resource_phase.priority: after technical pilot and before larger independent-source bank
multi_session_resource_phase.sources: metadata-only lexicographically first four members of the frozen existing-eight bank; two-source group is its first two; no output-based selection
multi_session_resource_phase.source_unit: four existing underlying speakers, not 24 independent source/run observations or new speakers
multi_session_resource_phase.release: same synchronous original ingress origin and 500ms cadence for all group members; all waiting obligations including EOS remain in the denominator
multi_session_resource_phase.resources: same two GPUs and two full FP32 model workers; Conservative is allowed to run different canonical chains on both cards
multi_session_resource_phase.references: new-runtime original full-task references for all four sources; isolated per-source reference binding plus actual grouped selected-transition and Consumer checks
multi_session_resource_phase.order: fixed seed, paired policy-order reversal and primary-GPU swap in repeat1; no performance-based removal
observables: all-offered D2/C8 credit and run passes
actual worker/model intervals by physical GPU
both-board energy to actual physical drain
legal selected full transitions and actual Consumer support
multi_session_resource_phase.legitimate_null: zero speculative dispatch and convergence when canonical chains fill both workers are meaningful boundary results, not pilot invalidity or a reason to retune until RevTrace wins
multi_session_resource_phase.interpretation_limit: two frozen mixtures test this allocation question; they do not establish maximum serving capacity or reproduce an external framework

subsequent_phase: Use actual pilot/resource evidence to decide highest-value next frozen study. Preserve proposed 96 existing-bank and 10N independent trials as plans, not automatic claims of necessity or executed results.
resource_accounting: worker/infer wall seconds and confirmation-time interval bounds are separate from CUDA active time, both-board energy and causal service gain
